description: The plot illustrates how AUC performance (in percent) varies as a function of the parameter \(N\) for five methods/series shown as colored lines. The x-axis is labeled “N”, uses a linear scale, and spans approximately 0 to 20 with major tick labels at 0, 5, 10, 15, and 20. The y-axis is labeled “AUC (%)”, uses a linear scale, and ranges from 75 to 100 with labeled ticks at 75, 80, 85, 90, and 100. A blue solid line with open circle markers starts near 94 at \(N=1\), rises to about 98 at \(N=5\) and stays about 98 at \(N=10\), then declines to about 96–97 at \(N=15\) and about 94–95 at \(N=20\). A red solid line with open square markers increases from about 87 at \(N=1\) to about 92 at \(N=5\) and about 98 at \(N=10\), then decreases to about 93 at \(N=15\) and about 91 at \(N=20\). A green solid line with star markers rises from about 86–87 at \(N=1\) to about 91 at \(N=5\), about 92–93 at \(N=10\), peaks around 94–95 at \(N=15\), and then drops to about 92–93 at \(N=20\). An orange solid line with open diamond markers increases from about 84 at \(N=1\) to about 92–93 at \(N=5\), about 94–95 at \(N=10\), about 95 at \(N=15\), and is about 94–95 at \(N=20\). A purple solid line with open downward triangle markers is about 79 at \(N=1\) and \(N=5\), rises sharply to about 96–97 at \(N=10\), then falls to about 85–86 at \(N=15\) and about 82–83 at \(N=20\).
